zh.title: Austrian Airlines 售出最後三架 767-300ER　12 月 1 日結束定期營運
zh.summary: 最後三架 767-300ER 將售予美國 Cobra Aviation 拆解，首架 10 月離隊，其餘兩架於年底前交付。
body: Austrian Airlines 已確認將最後三架 Boeing 767-300ER 售予美國 Cobra Aviation，買方計畫拆解飛機供應零組件。三架飛機註冊號為 OE-LAZ、OE-LAY 與 OE-LAE。
依航空公司說法，OE-LAZ 將於 10 月調離，其餘兩架在 2026 年底前交付。最後一班 Austrian 767 定期航班預定於 12 月 1 日抵達維也納。
這三架飛機機齡約 26 至 27.8 年，目前仍用於部分北美航線。退役安排將正式結束 767 在 Austrian 定期客運機隊的服務。

en.title: Austrian Airlines sells final three 767-300ERs, ending scheduled service December 1
en.summary: The aircraft are being sold to US buyer Cobra Aviation for part-out, with the first leaving in October and the other two by year-end.
body: Austrian Airlines has confirmed the sale of its final three Boeing 767-300ERs to US-based Cobra Aviation, which plans to part out the aircraft. The airframes are registered OE-LAZ, OE-LAY and OE-LAE.
The airline says OE-LAZ will ferry out in October, followed by the other two before the end of 2026. The final scheduled Austrian 767 service is due to arrive in Vienna on December 1.
The three aircraft are about 26 to 27.8 years old and remain assigned to selected North American services. Their retirement will close the 767 chapter in Austrian's scheduled passenger fleet.

facts.claim: Austrian Airlines confirmed the sale of its final three 767-300ERs to Cobra Aviation for part-out.
The aircraft are OE-LAZ, OE-LAY and OE-LAE; the first is due to leave in October and the others before year-end.
The last scheduled Austrian 767 flight is due to arrive in Vienna on 2026-12-01.
